title: Projector Pane: Multi-Workspace Rail & Tenant Switch Flow (prototype + review)
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem statement: Current console navigation fragments the mental model for customers running multiple tenants/workspaces and for platform teams toggling between cost dashboards, rollout controls and per-route traces. This ticket proposes a 'Projector Pane' pattern: a lightweight, composable rail that surfaces a workspace-aware primary rail plus a contextual secondary pane (projector) for dashboards, rollouts, and quick workspace tools. The goal is faster context switches, fewer accidental navs, and clear deep-linking semantics across hosted/dedicated/private deployments.

Scope: high-fidelity prototype of the new rail + projector pane, clickable flows for workspace switching (including role-aware state), cost pinning into projector, rollout quick-actions, and route preservation. Deliverables: Figma prototype, annotated design spec, usability testing notes, accessibility checklist, and a small engineering handoff package (component sketches and interaction matrix).
acceptance_criteria: Clickable Figma prototype covering primary rail, projector open/close, and workspace switch microflow
Design spec with routing rules and deep-link examples for pinned dashboards and rollouts
Usability test (n=8) complete with tasks: switch workspace, open cost projector, start a canary rollout from projector
Accessibility audit: keyboard focus, screen reader labels, 4.5:1 contrast for text on rails
Eng sign-off on feasibility and a small implementation spike (ENG-4723) scheduled
activity: 2026-02-25: Created by Aisha — initial problem framing and first wireframes attached. Called out confusion between top-nav workspace dropdown and left rail workspace entry points.

2026-03-02: Design sync with PM (Lena Morris) and Eng (Marco Li). Decided to keep primary rail actions persistent and animate projector in from the right to preserve spatial context. Action: prototype two animation speeds for perf testing.

2026-03-05: Figma prototype v1 complete and uploaded. Link shared with stakeholders for asynchronous feedback. Noted potential collision with existing console-wide keyboard shortcut (Cmd+K). Action: propose Cmd+J for projector quick-jump as alternative.
2026-03-07: PM review — requested explicit affordance for 'pin cost view' so users can pin a per-workspace cost dashboard to the projector. Added a pinned-states model and deep-linking examples.

2026-03-09: Engineering feedback — ENG flagged KV-cache and route hydration concerns for Private deployments when switching tenants. Added dependency ENG-4723 for a small spike to validate route state preservation across VPC contexts.
2026-03-11: Usability test plan approved. Recruit internal customers from SRE and Solutions teams for prototype sessions (scheduled 2026-03-15 through 2026-03-18).

2026-03-12: Design review scheduled. Consolidated notes and updated prototype to v2 with improved focus ring, reduced motion option, and explicit 'Return to previous route' toggle for pinned projector items.
notes:
Design decisions: 1) Use a persistent primary rail with a slim visual separator and context-aware icons; 2) Projector pane should be sticky per workspace when pinned; 3) Workspace switch preserves last projector state unless user clears pin; 4) Rollout actions accessible from projector must surface confirmation modals and fallback to safe-rollback; 5) For Dedicated/Private customers, hide any cloud-region rapid-jump links to avoid network surprises.

Open questions: performance budget for animations on low-end browsers, telemetry events to capture (projector_open, projector_pin, workspace_switch), and whether pinned projector items should be shareable via deep links.
